title: Tassili Rock Art Coming Alive
description: Neolithic rock art of Tassili n'Ajjer where the painted figures seem to step off the wall — giraffes, hunters, dancers, shamans all subtly gaining volume, the sandstone glowing in desert dusk.

zh-CN.title: 塔西利岩画复活
zh-CN.description: 新石器时代塔西利岩画 · 画中人物似要走出石壁 · 长颈鹿、猎人、舞者、巫师微微浮出立体 · 砂岩被沙漠黄昏染金。
